copy.gary: I've been wandering Clearwater parks and I still find something new on most visits, like the sunset crowd at Pier 60 or a quiet boardwalk at Moccasin Lake Nature Park.
copy.description: Check in at every Clearwater, Florida park you visit, collect stamps and badges, rate your favorites and explore with your Park Pals.
copy.made_for: Clearwater, from the bay to the beach

motifs.name: Sunsets at Pier 60
motifs.blurb: Every evening a crowd gathers at Pier 60 on Clearwater Beach to watch the sun drop into the Gulf, with street performers and artists along the way.

motifs.name: Clearwater Beach
motifs.blurb: Clearwater Beach’s soft white sand is regularly named one of the best beaches in the country.

motifs.name: Winter the dolphin
motifs.blurb: Clearwater Marine Aquarium was home to Winter, the dolphin with a prosthetic tail whose story became the movie Dolphin Tale.

motifs.name: The Memorial Causeway
motifs.blurb: The tall arch of the Clearwater Memorial Causeway Bridge carries you from downtown over the bay to the beach.

motifs.name: Coachman Park
motifs.blurb: Downtown’s Coachman Park, on the bluff over Clearwater Harbor, has a waterfront amphitheater, The BayCare Sound, for concerts and festivals.

motifs.name: Spring training
motifs.blurb: Every February and March the Philadelphia Phillies play spring training games at BayCare Ballpark.

motifs.name: Brown pelicans
motifs.blurb: Brown pelicans glide along the shore and perch on the docks and piers, waiting for a fisherman to share.
